A look inside

From one sentence to a sorted day.

How it works

Three steps for every record.

  1. 1

    Say or write one line

    Use text, voice, or a photo containing text. Plans and expenses can share the same sentence.

  2. 2

    Review the suggestions

    JotIt lists the parsed events and expenses, labelled as AI-generated. Times, amounts and categories stay editable.

  3. 3

    Confirm to save

    Save to your device once it looks right. Remove single entries or cancel the whole batch.

What it does

Schedules, tasks and spending in one app.

Capture fast

Natural phrases such as “next Wednesday afternoon” or “end of the month”; one paragraph can create several records.

See your day

Calendar views, schedules, tasks and reminders together, with default reminders, quiet hours and recurring events.

Track spending

Record income and expenses, then review totals by date, category and month. Amounts are calculated on device.

AI chat

Ask “What’s on this week?” or “How much did I spend on dining last month?” and get summaries, comparisons and suggestions.

Widgets and Watch

Check upcoming plans from Home Screen widgets and Apple Watch without opening the app.

Backup and migration

Import, export and create local backups. Export first, then restore on a new phone.

Privacy and control

The choice stays yours.

Local

Records stay on device

Schedules, expenses, nickname and avatar are stored on your iPhone by default. No cloud copy is created.

Optional

Online AI is opt-in

Off by default. Only necessary text is sent, only for requests you make. Original images are never uploaded.

Reversible

Permissions can be withdrawn

Turn off permissions, clear records, disable optional usage analytics, export a backup or delete local data.

JotIt includes no advertising SDK, does no cross-app ad tracking and does not sell personal information. See the full privacy policy.

Pricing

Start free. Add Pro when you need more AI.

Introductory

100 AI credits in total for your first 30 days.

Free plan

60 AI credits per UTC calendar month afterwards.

Pro Monthly

CNY 18/month reference price, 600 AI credits per month.

Pro Annual

CNY 128/year reference price, 600 AI credits per month.

Standard online AI requests use 1 credit; long text or complex analysis uses 3. Annual plans are billed yearly while credits reset monthly, and unused credits do not roll over. Prices above are the mainland China reference prices — your local price and currency appear on the App Store purchase screen.

Local schedules, expenses, reminders, backup, restore and export are always free and are never locked when AI credits run out.
